compatibility_note: Consumers MUST fail closed unless the manifest's top-level schema_version string exactly equals accepted_schema_version. Producers emitting any other version are rejected intentionally; never parse an unversioned or mismatched manifest silently.
governance: Single source of truth for the Product Studio manifest schema_version contract. Both the JS consumer and Python-side schema governance read this file; change it only via a reviewed commit that updates producer and consumers together.
